lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: Every roll held its shape all the way to my mouth. None of them were mine. Ideal.

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: a whole page i could order from, and a room quiet enough to hear maya's news twice :)

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: two dollar signs. nothing to bring up at future dinners. you're all very lucky

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: Peanut in the sauces, peanut on the rolls. I threw that dressing in the bin on Sunday for exactly this reason. I'm not staying.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: cyrus warned us about peanut dressing an hour ago and half this menu comes with it spooned on top?? i'm literally leaving this chat

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: everyone up. cyrus walks out first and we follow him

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: i've read the menu twice... there's fish or meat in every single roll

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: I set a standard for Mina and then didn't hold to it. Mina, I'm sorry. We're leaving.

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: nope. mina is not eating plain rice while we all tuck in. coats on

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: three dollar signs. it was delicious, and i will be mentioning it at every dinner until the coast. starting now

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: worth every piece. next coffee's on me, so at least that part stays off the list

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: the rolls are lovely, but it's so loud in here that maya's told me about her job three times and i've caught about half

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: even i think this room is too much tonight. let's take the rest of the story out to the boardwalk

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: every roll here comes battered and fried. i gave up my noisy room tonight and still got the fryer

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: For the record, they still held together better than mine.

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: Calm, lovely, and Greek. After eleven attempts this week, I was hoping someone would hand me a properly rolled one.

lines.speaker: mina
lines.text: the quiet was perfect though, i heard every word of maya's news :) we'll find cyrus his rolls next time
